Batch scrape with one URL failing returns partial results

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
urls = ['https://example.com/good1', 'https://example.com/bad', 'https://example.com/good2']
result = Crawlberg.batch_scrape(engine, urls)
puts result.completed_count.inspect
puts result.failed_count.inspect
puts result.total_count.inspect
```
